components.name: Slider

components.description: Slider picks one number from a range: a volume, a size, a position in a recording. A label row names it and can show the value in words the app writes; the track and thumb are the primitive slider.

props.name: bind

props.description: Runs with each new value while dragging, snapped to `step`.

props.name: label
props.description: The visible label and the slider's accessible name.

props.name: isLabelHidden
props.description: Hides the visible label; the slider keeps it as its name.

props.name: valueLabel
props.description: The value in words, drawn at the end of the label row and read after the name: "40%", "1:24 of 3:10". Liuli formats no numbers.

props.name: description

props.name: step
props.description: The value snaps to it.

props.name: variant
props.description: `row` sits in a list group among `Item` rows: the row's padding, the Item label style, the value at the end in muted.

components.name: Tabs
components.summary: A row of tabs over one panel, as an underline or a segmented control
components.description: Tabs switch one area between a few peers: sections of a page, or modes of one view. The tabs share the row equally, and a single indicator slides to the chosen one.

props.description: Names the tab list for assistive tech: "Range", "Sections".

props.name: items
props.description: The tabs, in order; they share the row equally.

props.name: value

props.name: onChange
props.description: Runs with the tab chosen by a tap or by arrowing onto it.

props.name: variant
props.description: `underline` switches between sections of a page; `segmented` switches one view between modes.

props.name: children
props.description: The chosen tab's panel.

props.name: data-testid
props.description: On the tab list; each tab gets `<testid>-<value>`, the panel `<testid>-panel`.

accessibility.name: label

keyboard.effect: Into the row, on the chosen tab; again, on to the panel.

notes: The chosen state is in the text weight and colour and in the indicator, never in colour alone.

components.name: TextInput
components.summary: Single-line text field with label, help text, status and an optional clear button
components.description: TextInput is a labelled one-line editor for names, emails, codes, amounts and searches. Bind it to a `useLocal` cell for View-local drafts, or pass `value` and `onChange` when the app owns the text.

props.name: label
props.description: The visible label and the control's accessible name.

props.name: isLabelHidden
props.description: Hides the visible label; the control keeps it as its name.

props.name: description
props.description: Help text under the control, read as the control's description.

props.name: status
props.description: An `error` status marks the control invalid; its message is read as the control's description.

props.name: isRequired
props.description: Marks the label with an asterisk and the control as required. Validation is the app's.

props.name: hasRequiredMark
props.description: Draws the asterisk on a required label; turn it off on a form where every field is required.

props.name: disabledMessage
props.description: Shown in place of `description` while disabled.

props.name: bind
props.description: A View-local cell the control reads and writes; use it or `value` with `onChange`.

props.name: value
props.description: The app's value; pass `onChange` with it.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Runs with the new value; the app passes it back as `value`.

props.name: hasClear
props.description: A button that empties the text, shown while there is text.

props.name: clearLabel
props.description: The clear button's accessible name; required with `hasClear`.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: A hint shown while empty; never a substitute for `label`.

props.name: type
props.description: `search` draws Liuli's magnifier, not the platform's, and defaults `enterKeyHint` to `search`.

props.name: enterKeyHint
props.description: The label of the keyboard's action key; `onSubmit` runs on it.

props.name: hasSpellCheck
props.description: Unset follows the platform.

props.name: hasAutoFocus
props.description: Focus it when it first appears.

props.name: startIcon
props.description: An icon inside the box, before the text; drawn 16 px in the muted colour. Replaces the search magnifier.

props.name: onSubmit
props.description: The keyboard's action key, or Enter.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the field column.

props.name: controlClassName
props.description: Classes for the bordered box.

props.name: data-testid
props.description: On the editor.

accessibility.name: label
notes: The clear button is a separate control named by `clearLabel`.
Sizes sm (32) and md (40) are below the 44 pt touch minimum; on touch layouts prefer lg until hit slop lets the press area extend past the paint.
